One of the ancient [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] from the early days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the '''Koros Trunk Line''' began as a connection between [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and Koros Major, later known as [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]]. The route, which was discovered with the method of [[S-thread booster/Legends|S-thread boosters]],<ref name="TEA" /> was used to supply Coruscant with [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] from Koros and became known as the '''Carbonite Pipeline'''. It triggered an exploration boom towards the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].

It stretched past [[Kuar]], [[Foerost/Legends|Foerost]], and [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]] before arriving at Coruscant.

In front of the [[Hyperspace Navigator's Guildhouse/Legends|Hyperspace Navigator's Guildhouse]] is a [[Monument to lost navigators/Legends|Monument to Lost Navigators]], a massive [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] statue of the ancient, unnamed patriarch of the [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] family that allegedly blazed the Koros Trunk Line on a [[Generation ship/Legends|generation ship]].<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>
